description: The Conductor admin helper's allowlist (docs/admin-helper.md). The elevated runner runs only these actions, from scripts copied into C:\ProgramData\ConductorAdmin\actions at install; src/main/admin-helper.ts must list the same actions (a test checks it).

firewall-candidate-cleanup.summary: Remove the inbound Windows Firewall rules Windows created for Conductor acceptance candidates and smoke worktrees (electron.exe under a conductor-candidates or .conductor-scratch folder). Never touches the installed Conductor.exe, the main checkout's electron.exe or any other program's rules.

dryRun.summary: list what would be removed without removing it
